name: PerfectPixel
summary: Drops a semi-transparent mockup (PNG/JPG/SVG) onto the live page with opacity, blend modes and click-through controls so the build can be compared against the design pixel-for-pixel.
price: Freemium (free tier 2 layers per domain; paid Pro per store text)
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the store page.
goodFor: Comparing a design overlay against the live build, pixel for pixel.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: pixel perfect overlay compare mockup design QA blend opacity
